text:
- mug_priya: Repeatedly misplaced between kitchen_table_k1, cupboard_k1, and coffee_table_l1. Pattern: I assumed it stayed in the kitchen or moved to the living room based on general activity, but it actually shifts frequently between the kitchen table and living room coffee table. Next time, check coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1 first, as these are its primary resting spots.
- glass_priya: Erroneously assumed it remained in the kitchen (sink_k1 or kitchen_table_k1) or moved to the bedroom nightstand only at the very end. Pattern: I failed to track its movement to nightstand_b1 earlier in the evening. Next time, prioritize checking nightstand_b1 if the query is late in the evening, as it is often taken to the bedroom.
- water_bottle_priya: Confused its location between kitchen_table_k1 and dish_rack_k1. Pattern: I assumed it was being washed or stored in the dish rack, but it was actually on the kitchen table for most of the day, only moving to the dish rack briefly. Next time, default to kitchen_table_k1 unless there is specific evidence of washing.
- razor_priya: Previous note assumed sink_ba_ba1; actually bathroom_shelf_ba1. Still relevant as a single instance, but no new errors today. Continue to rely on bathroom_shelf_ba1.
- General Note: The "one-off" assessment from day 1 was incorrect for mug_priya, glass_priya, and water_bottle_priya. These items show high mobility and frequent location changes within the kitchen and living areas. Do not assume static positions for these items; always consider recent movement patterns and check multiple likely spots (kitchen table, coffee table, dish rack, nightstand) before answering.
